ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.3-T34D.2.3 Lean Live V2.2
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Evidence-curated D.2.3 baseline for RimWorld 1.5. V2.2 removes the S4 closest-search replacement and T8 carrier/mech path after V2.1 showed high validator volume without demonstrated net time savings. The DLL retains synchronous DoBill, Common Sense, merge and text-cache paths plus only the minimal package scope they require. It excludes T34 fabrics, workers, dispatchers, Clean Pathfinding hooks and all validator, reachability or reservation replay.
